title: Dante
wikitext: {{Infobox/Mayor |aka = Mayor Dante }} '''Dante''' was a one time special Mayoral Candidate that appeared in the Year 128 [[Mayor Election]]. He offered three perks, Order, Security and Freedom, which changed once he was elected. After Dante was elected, [[Clerk Seraphine]] started building the [[The Uprising|Resistance Movement]] at the [[Dark Auction]], which lead to an election for the [[Resistance Leader]] to lead [[Resistance Movement|The Uprising]], the final boss fight in which players kill Dante. [[File:Dante Banner.png|alt=Dante's banner|thumb|Dante's banner]] == Mayoral Perks == Most special mayors run with up to four unique perks, but Dante has only been seen with three perks. '''Perks''': #'''Order''': Establish order #'''Security''': Strengthen security #'''Freedom''': Freedom from fear However, when Dante was elected, his real perks are revealed and are as follows: '''Changes List''': * Economy Restoration (Establish Order) ** Double [[Auction House|AH]] & [[Bazaar]] Tax ** 10% [[Coins|coin]] tax on [[Shops]] *** All NPC items have had their price increased by 10%. This did not affect selling items to NPCs. ** {{c|10}} per minute fee for chatting ** {{c|2}} toll on travelling between islands *** This perk did not affect the /warpforge command. * Increase Security (Strengthen Security) ** Hired goons to protect [[Official Buildings|official buildings]] *** [[Goons]] would deny entry to most of the [[Official Buildings|public buildings]], excluding the [[Community Center]] where Dante is located, for players who were not wearing [[Happy Mask]] or did not have a [[Dante's Talisman]] with them. ** Cancelled hazardous events *** The [[Traveling Zoo]], [[Spooky Festival]] and [[Season of Jerry|Season of Jerry Event]] were canceled. The [[New Year Celebration]] was still held. *** The [[Mayor Election|Mayor Elections]] were replaced with [[Mayor Election#Dante Election|Dante Elections]], where only Dante could be elected. ** Decreased sunlight, prevent sunburn *** The time of the day on the entire server was set to midnight, no matter what the actual in-game time was. This perk was not added until several days after Dante was elected. (This didn't affect islands with a [[Day Saver]].) * In the hours leading up to [[The Uprising]], Dante introduced several more changes: ** [[Dungeons]] were banned, which means no players could participate in Dungeons. ** [[Pets]] were disabled, meaning no Pets could be equipped. ** The alliance with the Dwarves was disbanded, barring access to the [[Dwarven Mines]]. ** The [[Auction House|AH]] and [[Bazaar]] were disabled, preventing people from buying items. ** Eventually, traveling between islands itself was banned, forcing everyone into the [[Hub]] to fight Dante. All of Dante's changes were reverted when [[Technoblade]] became mayor following [[The Uprising]]. == Interface == {{/UI}} == Dialogue == {{/Dialogue}} == Message in the Hub, from Dante == After the popular Hypixel YouTuber Technoblade went [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hv5tNAG1r_c live] about the [[Resistance Movement]], a [https://twitter.com/HypixelNetwork/status/1379932943062167552 Twitter message] from Hypixel's official Twitter, revealed a message from Dante. This message replaces the map in the [[Hub]]. {{Collapsible Section Button|Click to see Dante's message|id=dante-message}} {{Collapsible Section|[[File:Dante MSG.jpg|512px]]|id=dante-message}} == Boss Fight == {{Infobox/Generic |image=Huge_Slime.png }} [[File:Ruins of the Hub Dante.jpg|thumb|The Hub in ruins after the Dante boss fight|alt=]] During the boss fight against the [[The Uprising|Resistance]], Dante unleashed [[Goons]] into the hub. Once they were defeated, he morphed into a giant Slime and started destroying the [[Hub Island|Hub]]. He could only be damaged using the [[Staff of the Rising Sun]]. Receiving damage from Dante would result in the following message: {{Dialogue|&c&lDante &r&cstruck you for # damage!}} During the boss fight players were able to look up to support [[Resistance Leader|Technoblade]]. Doing so resulted in the following message in the chat: {{Dialogue|&b&lENERGY BALL&r&e: You are sending mana to &dTechnoblade&e!}} After Dante was defeated, the following message appeared in the chat: {{Dialogue|$[c]&e&l{{Dashline}} &b&lDANTE IS NO MORE! &b&lIT TOOK AN ARMY OF TENS OF THOUSANDS! &b&lBUT WE PREVAILED! &b&lTHE SUN RISES AGAIN! &b&lTIME TO START REBUILDING OUR VILLAGE! $[c]&e&l{{Dashline}}}} == Dante Tomb == After [https://hypixel.net/threads/skyblock-0-11-4.4145813|Patch 0.11.4], Dante's Tomb appeared in the [[Graveyard]] at {{Coordinates|-89|75|-133}}. The tomb features mostly gray palate-type blocks of Stone and some Cobblestone Walls. There is a gray Dante statue standing on top of the tomb. Clicking the statue shows the following message in chat: {{Dialogue|&7In Memoriam &7While Dante will be remembered as a cruel tyrant, his righteous ideals live on in people's hearts. &7dante &6best}} == Trivia == * Jayavarmen mentioned a new special candidate in a [https://twitter.com/jayavarmen/status/1376941661733982221 tweet] stating, "don't vote for them." This ended up to be Dante. * '''Dante''' seems to be the opposite of [[Derpy]], as [[Derpy]] appears to want chaos while Dante wants order. * '''Dante''' is the fourth special mayor, replacing the spot of [[Derpy]] in Year 128. * When he got elected, a secret [[Resistance Movement|movement]] in the [[Dark Auction|Dark Auction House]] appeared. * Before April 12, one wouldn't lose coins upon dying even if they didn't have a Cookie Buff or a Piggy Bank. This turned out to be a glitch and got patched. * Dante, once he got elected: ** Introduced a new soundtrack (made by ShinkoNet) into the [[Hub Island|Hub]]. ** Drained the color from buildings in the [[Hub Island|Hub]] and modified them. For example, the fish on the [[Fish Merchant|Fish Merchant's]] house turned into a fish skeleton and the [[Event Stand]] was boarded up. ** Changed the [[Hub Island|Hub]] biome to desert. ** Replaced the well in the [[Village]] with his [[Golden Dante Statue|statue]]. ** Replaced normal [[Mayor Election|Mayor Elections]] with [[Mayor Election#Dante Election|Dante Elections]] in which he's the only candidate. ** Changed the result of the [[Mayor Election|election]] he's been elected in into 100% votes for him, in-game displayed as "100% - All Votes" instead of the true percentage and amount of votes. ** Added a message from him against the resistance replacing the hub map, lasting for the time he is elected. ** Hung green-gray-black banners on some buildings in the [[Hub Island|Hub]]. * The message Dante had in the [[Hub Island|Hub]] had a chance to be glitched on some lobbies. * After [[The Uprising]] has ended, saying "dante" in the chat triggered the in-game swear filter. This was removed a few weeks later. * Dante introduced 3 soundtracks, which are [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hVQoq_7ErXo Dark and Seedy], [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UzNqODe-bvg Dark and Seedy (Pre-Revolt)] and [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oWXmQZnfRps Breathless Encounter]. * When in boss form, even though Dante had a health bar, when he reached the wizard tower his health bar would always drop to 0%, no matter what. * The [[Commands|command]] {{Code|/killdante}} was used in Technoblade's Uprising livestream. The command is now disabled. ** The command was later referenced with {{NPCSprite|Bacte}} and {{NPCSprite|Aura}}. * A memorial to Dante exists in the [[Graveyard]] at {{Coordinates|-90|75|-130}}. You can find more information [[Graveyard#Dante_Memorial|here]]. * Dante and [[Bacte]] share a striking resemblance, but aren't necessarily related. * According to [[Elise (Rift)|Elise]], Wizards believe that [[Shen]] employed, or perhaps even created '''Dante'''. Another possibility is that [[Shen]] got in the [[Rift Dimension]] before the Wizards, and found Dante there. == History == {{History table |beta= {{History|2021/March 31|[[File:Dante.png|26px]] Added '''Dante'''.|Players don't lose coins on death.|link=none}} {{History|2021/April 4|'''Dante''' was elected and perks were revealed.|link=none}} {{History|2021/April 7|link=none|Map in the [[Hub]] replaced by a message from '''Dante'''.[[File:Dante_MSG.jpg|32px]]}} {{History|2021/April 9|link=none|New addition to "Increase Security" perk: "Decreased sunlight, prevent sunburn".}} {{History|2021/April 12|Players now lose {{c}} on death.|link=none}} {{History|2021/April 14|Chatting now costs {{c|10}} per minute, {{c|5}} before.|link=none}} {{History|2021/April 16|link=none |Mining Islands, the [[Dwarven Mines]], [[Dungeon]]s, the [[Auction House]], the [[Bazaar]] and [[Pet]]s were considered safety concern and have been outlawed (canceled). |[[The Uprising]] defeated '''Dante'''. |Saying "dante" in the chat now triggers the swear filter.}} {{History|2021/May 1|link=none|Saying "dante" now no longer triggers the swear filter.}} }} == Navigation == {{Nav/Mayors}} {{Nav/The Uprising}} {{Nav/Characters}} {{Nav/Events/Mayor Election}} [[Category:Mayor]] [[Category:Mayor Election]]
